theory.title: Pide y da indicaciones para llegar a un lugar
theory.explanation: Para pedir ayuda, empieza con “Excuse me” y pregunta “Where is the…?” o “How do I get to the…?”. Para indicar el camino, usa imperativos sencillos: “Go straight on”, “Turn left/right” y “Cross the road”. Para situar edificios, utiliza preposiciones y expresiones de lugar: “next to”, “opposite”, “between…and…”, “behind”, “in front of” y “near”.
theory.tip: Primero identifica el lugar de destino. Después escucha las acciones en orden. En “between” necesitas dos referencias: between A and B. “Opposite” significa enfrente, al otro lado.

patterns.label: Ask for a place
patterns.pattern: Excuse me, where is the + place?
examples: Excuse me, where is the library?

patterns.label: Ask for directions
patterns.pattern: How do I get to the + place?
examples: How do I get to the station?

patterns.label: Go straight
examples: Go straight on for two streets.

patterns.label: Turn right
examples: Turn right at the traffic lights.

patterns.label: Cross a road
examples: Cross the road at the traffic lights.

patterns.label: Say next to
examples: The bank is next to the supermarket.

patterns.label: Say opposite
examples: The café is opposite the park.

patterns.label: Say between
patterns.pattern: A is between B and C.
examples: The school is between the bank and the shop.

patterns.label: Say in front of
patterns.pattern: A is in front of B.
examples: The bus stop is in front of the museum.

content.audioTranscript: Excuse me, where is the museum? Go straight on and turn right at the corner. Cross the road at the traffic lights. The museum is next to the library. The café is opposite the park. The bank is between the shop and the hotel. The bus stop is in front of the school. Thank you for your help. You're welcome. Have a nice day!
